paper_title: Searching for Dark Matter with a Superconducting Qubit
notes: Superconducting transmon qubit QND photon-counting search for hidden photon dark matter in a 6.011 GHz (24.86 ueV) storage cavity. On-resonance limit epsilon <= 1.68e-15 at 90% CL given explicitly in text. Side points are the -3dB sensitivity points 3 kHz off resonance (limit degraded by sqrt(2)), inferred from the stated lineshape (Q_DM ~ 1e6); exact off-resonant exclusion bands (odd multiples of 2chi, spanning ~6.000-6.022 GHz per Fig. 4) not tabulated in the paper. Assumes hidden photon is all of local DM with rho = 0.4 GeV/cm^3.
